note: Used by scripts/build-status.mjs. areaByRegion: the area name the status page shows for each region key in resorts.js. areaOverride: resorts shown under a different area. az: written answers for the A to Z that say more than the standard sentence, each with the status it was written for (dropped automatically when the status changes).

Royalton Blue Waters.text: Is Royalton Blue Waters open? Yes — Royalton Blue Waters is open and welcoming guests in Montego Bay, Jamaica (reopened September 2026).

Royalton Hideaway Blue Waters.text: Is Royalton Hideaway Blue Waters open? (formerly Royalton White Sands Montego Bay) Yes — Royalton Hideaway Blue Waters is open and welcoming guests in Montego Bay, Jamaica (reopened September 2026).

RIU Palace Jamaica.text: Is RIU Palace Jamaica open? RIU Palace Jamaica is currently closed for refurbishment and reopening 12 Dec 2026 in Montego Bay, Jamaica.

Coyaba Beach Resort.text: Is Zoetry Montego Bay open? Not yet. Zoetry Montego Bay is closed and reopening under its original name, Coyaba Beach Resort, in Montego Bay, Jamaica. The reopening date is not confirmed yet.

Catalonia Montego Bay.text: Is Catalonia Montego Bay open? (formerly Holiday Inn Resort Montego Bay All Inclusive) Catalonia Montego Bay is currently closed in Montego Bay, Jamaica. It is being converted into a 522-room Marriott Hotels All-Inclusive Resort — Marriott's first all-inclusive in Montego Bay — expected to open in 2028.
